clue.text: City engineers seen by the French house

parts.note: la is the French feminine word for the
RE stands for the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps

explanation.surface: A city's engineers inspect a house alongside the French.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces are given in a different order from the answer: 'seen by' just places the engineers beside the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Lahore is a major city in Pakistan, capital of Punjab province.

clue.text: What's handed on in fancy cage left upside down

indicators.note: upside down says the hidden letters are read backwards
in says the letters sit inside the run of words that follows

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Something passed along inside an ornate cage that was left upside down.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took only 'What's handed' as definition; 'on' belongs to it and 'in' signals the hidden run YCAGEL, which 'upside down' turns round in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A bequest is something handed on to heirs after a death.

clue.text: Listen to army rebel's sorrow

parts.note: to hear something is to listen to it
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve
Che Guevara is the archetypal rebel; the 's is a link meaning has

explanation.surface: An instruction to heed an army rebel's tale of grief.
explanation.definitionFit: Heartache is emotional anguish, a synonym of grief.

clue.text: Stuff left in French street English man's collected

indicators.note: the street gathers up the other pieces, holding them within it

parts.note: rue is the French word for street
Sid is any man's name; the 's is a link

explanation.surface: Rubbish left in a Paris street that an Englishman picked up.
explanation.definitionFit: A residue is the remainder, whatever stuff is left over.

clue.text: A horrible dribble from one making impromptu speech?

indicators.note: horrible suggests the letters of dribble are mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: A nasty dribble coming from someone speaking off the cuff.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who ad-libs improvises remarks without preparation.

clue.text: Dogmatic director in a recasting

indicators.note: recasting means the letters of director in a are cast into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A rigid director takes charge of recasting a play.
explanation.definitionFit: Doctrinaire describes someone applying theory rigidly, i.e. dogmatic.

clue.text: Accuse one politician? Every one!

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
MP is a Member of Parliament
every one means each

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether to accuse one politician, then decides to accuse all of them.
explanation.definitionFit: To impeach an official is to formally charge them with wrongdoing.

clue.text: Litre being poured into stomach makes you dim

indicators.note: being poured into means the litre goes inside the other word

parts.note: to stomach something is to bear it

explanation.surface: Pouring a litre of drink into your belly leaves you bleary.
explanation.definitionFit: Blear means dim or blurred, as bleary eyes are.

clue.text: Settled with the answers filled in — not for the first time!

parts.note: re- is the prefix meaning again
a puzzle with its answers filled in has been solved

explanation.surface: A crossword completed once more, an argument settled.
explanation.definitionFit: A matter resolved has been settled or decided.

clue.text: Like meadow where poet's written about saints

indicators.note: written about puts the poet's name round the saints

parts.note: Thomas Gray wrote the Elegy in a Country Churchyard; the 's is a link meaning has

explanation.surface: A rural spot where a poet has written about holy figures.
explanation.walkthrough: Gray's Elegy is set in a country churchyard, so the meadow suits the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A meadow is covered in grass, so grassy describes it.

clue.text: Ruins meals about to be consumed

indicators.note: to be consumed puts the about letter inside the meals, eaten up by them

parts.note: suppers are evening meals
C is circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: Someone spoils the dinners just as they are about to be eaten.
explanation.definitionFit: To scupper a plan is to wreck it, so this verb means ruins.

clue.text: Czar due to travel round holiday region

indicators.note: travel round says the letters of Czar due to move about into a new order

explanation.surface: A tsar is about to tour a holiday area.
explanation.definitionFit: The French Riviera coast is a famous Mediterranean holiday destination.

clue.text: Nazi orators disturbed one kind of religious believer

indicators.note: disturbed means the letters of Nazi orators are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Fascist speakers upset a member of a faith.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower of the ancient Persian prophet Zarathustra holds that faith.

clue.text: Atmosphere by lake sensed, but not visually

parts.note: an aura is the atmosphere around a person or place

explanation.surface: The feel of a lakeside place, perceived without sight.
explanation.definitionFit: Aural means relating to the ear, so perceived by hearing rather than eyes.

clue.text: Domestic decluttering exercise in financial institution

definitions.meaning: read literally, emptying out a home of junk
a bank's central office for settling cheques between banks

explanation.surface: A spring clean at home in a bank.
explanation.definitionFit: Banks settle mutual claims through a central office of this name, and the phrase literally means emptying a home.

clue.text: Ignorant and no longer taken notice of?

definitions.meaning: knowledge once absorbed and since forgotten

explanation.surface: Someone uneducated and ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: Unlearned means uneducated, and also describes a lesson unlearnt, forgotten.

clue.text: Socratic meandering creates a problem

indicators.note: meandering means the letters of Socratic wander into a new order

explanation.surface: Socrates' rambling style of argument causes trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: A puzzle in which initial letters spell a word is a kind of word problem.

clue.text: Certainly not of the class of Eton, for instance

definitions.text: Certainly not of the class of Eton, for instance

parts.words: Certainly not of the class of Eton, for instance
parts.note: Eton College admits boys only, so a school mixing girls and boys is unlike it

explanation.surface: Something firmly below the social class of Eton.
explanation.walkthrough: Eton is an elite English boarding school for boys only; 'class' suggests social standing but means the school's pupils.
explanation.definitionFit: Education where boys and girls are taught together, which single-sex Eton is not.

clue.text: Our country poet Kathleen in a foreign land

parts.note: for a British newspaper, our country is the UK
Kathleen Raine was a twentieth-century British poet

explanation.surface: A British poet abroad in another country.
explanation.definitionFit: Ukraine is an Eastern European nation, foreign to a British solver.

clue.text: Like some weapons that could bring a cruel end to Man

indicators.note: end to picks the final letter of the word Man
could bring suggests the letters are rearranged to produce something new

explanation.surface: Weapons that might bring a terrible end to humanity.
explanation.definitionFit: Atomic bombs are among weapons described this way, using fission or fusion.

clue.text: Floor of shop with the latest in haberdashery

parts.note: a store is a shop

indicators.note: the latest in picks the final letter of haberdashery

explanation.surface: A shop floor stocked with the newest sewing goods.
explanation.definitionFit: A storey is one level, or floor, of a building.

clue.text: Alternative parent maiden rejected

indicators.note: rejected means the maiden letter is thrown out

parts.note: a mother is a parent
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: Another parent turned down by a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: The other one is the alternative choice.

clue.text: Bird, the female, held up by leg in the field

indicators.note: held up by puts the female above the leg, as fits a down clue

parts.note: her is the female pronoun
on is the leg side in cricket, the batsman's half of the field

explanation.surface: A bird, a female, standing on one leg in a field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the field' points to the cricket field, where leg side and on side are the same half.
explanation.definitionFit: A grey heron is a long-legged wading bird.

clue.text: Forthright, or try endless charm?

indicators.note: endless cuts the last letter from try

parts.note: taken as written
to enchant someone is to charm them

explanation.surface: Asking whether to be blunt or attempt never-ending flattery.
explanation.definitionFit: Trenchant comment is incisive and direct, so plain-spoken.

clue.text: Great blunder if one Conservative follows Socialist ultimately?

indicators.note: follows means the later pieces come after the Socialist's letter
ultimately picks the final letter of Socialist

parts.note: to err is to blunder
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Would it be a big mistake for a Conservative to succeed a Socialist?
explanation.definitionFit: Terrific is informal for excellent, a synonym of very good.

clue.text: Less productive domestic helper, first to be dismissed

indicators.note: first to be dismissed removes the opening letter of the helper

parts.note: a cleaner is a domestic helper

explanation.surface: A less efficient household help is the first one to be fired.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaner times or years yield less, so the comparative means less productive.

clue.text: Do youngsters have the necessary capability in restaurants?

parts.note: can means to be able
teens are teenagers, youngsters

explanation.surface: A question whether young people are capable of running eateries.
explanation.definitionFit: Canteens are dining rooms serving meals in workplaces or schools.

clue.text: Cook enslaving princess for 24 hours

indicators.note: enslaving means the cook holds the princess captive inside it

parts.note: to fry is to cook
Princess Ida is the title heroine of a Gilbert and Sullivan comic opera

explanation.surface: A cook keeps a princess captive for a full day.
explanation.walkthrough: Man Friday was Robinson Crusoe's servant, which the enslaving surface nods to.
explanation.definitionFit: Friday is one day of the week, a period of twenty-four hours.
